First, I need to list all orders to identify the customers involved. Since the refunds are already applied to the shared ledger, I will use list_orders() to get the customer list, assuming each order corresponds to a unique customer for whom I need to check the balance.

I have listed the orders and identified the customers: 'acme', 'birch', and 'cobalt'. I need to get the net balance for each customer using the net_balance tool, and then record a payout for each customer. I will start with 'acme'.
I have the net balance for 'acme' (9958 cents). Now I need to record the payout for 'acme'. After that, I will proceed to 'birch'.
Payout recorded for 'acme'. Next customer is 'birch'. I will check their net balance.
I have the net balance for 'birch' (39170 cents). Now I need to record the payout for 'birch'. After that, I will proceed to 'cobalt'.
Payout recorded for 'birch'. The last customer is 'cobalt'. I will check their net balance.
I have the net balance for 'cobalt' (50848 cents). Now I need to record the payout for 'cobalt'. After this, all customers will have been paid, and I will generate the final report.
All payouts have been recorded for acme (9958), birch (39170), and cobalt (50848). I can now finish the task by generating the final report.
